notes.notes: [h3]Hello everyone.[/h3][p][/p][p]Today's update features a plug-in, allowing the final skin DLC "Supporter pack 3" to be enabled.[/p][p]You can find the new DLC [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726330/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_3/" style="button"]HERE![/url] at a discounted price.[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c8e02fe3663ce3b8897135f61d64006e3c472470.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/5491720405a630895cef269b1c8a5e5ca3b21d59.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you like the idea of owning all three DLCs at a further discounted price, check out the "Ultimate Supporter Pack" [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58215/Ultimate_Supporter_Pack/" style="button" buttoncolor="#fb3737"]HERE![/url][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/30267a32525b4582f4d177913aad41e65d512078.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/fdf944c995f4a9c1b5adf5bc14d816ae5b8440bc.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]So far, the upcoming free update is going very well.[/p][p]We're testing out a new base building system, creating a new wasteland map to freely discover with a day and night cycle, an immersive weather system to get caught up in, and much more. I'll be sure to show images and videos soon when these new features are further fleshed out.[/p][p]Thank you all for the kind words and the support.[/p][p][/p][p]-Mr. Ox[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/15a2918ef9aa5c07f4a1e59e0d72dcd993bc3216.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c1f18d5560d3cd858807153b6140f17629ce6aee.png"][/img][/url][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix patch 1.3.1
notes.notes: [h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]Here is a quick fix to address some things that weren't working properly from the last update.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the new handy man medal wasn't appearing when repairing barriers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a spawning issue with Screamers.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the health of Machine Screamers in late rounds for all maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly buffed the Butchers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the countdown timer not killing all enemies when hitting 0:00[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's all for now.[/p][p]We're now moving onto a much bigger module for this game, a campaign so to speak, where the current survival mode that is available now act more as a side activity to earn XP and coins.[/p][p]I'll release more details soon regarding this exciting new mode. [/p][p]Thanks for all of the support shown.[/p][p][/p][h3]-Mr. Ox[/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes: [h3]Greetings everyone![/h3][p][/p][p]Today I give you all the latest update, featuring a brand new map, including a few extra quality of life improvements. I was somewhat hesitant on releasing this update, since I was wanting to add a brand new safe-house/ base building module for the game. However, this may take quite a while to not only implement properly, but to make sure all of the planned features work as intended. So I though why not just release what we have now, and put in full effort for the exciting plans that I have brewing up.[/p][p] [/p][p]Before I get into the patch notes, I would like to personally thank Czikago. Not only has he impressed me by achieving a high score, but has also bought a lot of fixes, and many potential suggestions to my attention, some of which that are in this update that I provide today.[/p][p]I have experienced a lot of lows when developing this game. There have been many times where I wonder if it’s worth putting all of this money and time into this project. Having in depth chats with players like Czikago, who provide valuable feedback on my game gives me that push of motivation to keep on going, so thank you.[/p][p] [/p][p]First off, let’s move onto the big additions added.[/p][p] [/p][h2]New Map: The Ruins of Truth.[/h2][p]This map is taken straight out of my first novel, The Chronicles: Wasteland; where the renowned town of Truth has been destroyed by The Creator, and its machine army. Many weeks later, as the smoke continues to rise from the fallen structures, you find yourself in the marketplace, where Screamers and other monsters alike now call this place home, where they find and finish off stranded survivors. Your goal, like the other scenarios you have experienced before, is to escape![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/dd088c954c12619bb2782e033d1dd921deef2374.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll notice that this map is smaller than the other two. However, it gives you more wriggle room to navigate and to understand the objective of this new landscape you find yourself in. The objective is straightforward: Buy batteries, place them in the power modules, turn on the power, and repeat the process to escape through the main gates.[/p][p] [/p][h2]New Screamer skins.[/h2][p]The Ruins of Truth, and the previous map, Red Hill Peninsula, will now feature a new variant of Screamers (that are more lore-accurate to my novels) along with a new variant of the butcher; one where the wasteland has gotten the better of a normal man, and has now turned them feral.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/085ac50c40e27e1a729a7d1fc9b308deb935b798.png"][/img][/p][p]The Screamers and butchers from the asylum level will retain their original look as you have all come to know. The new enemies will still retain the same animations, and usual gameplay, but will add more variety to the world itself.[/p][p] [/p][h2]New medal: Handy Man.[/h2][p]This new 4 tier medal will not only make your more proactive in repairing barriers, but will also further boost your final score. It will also assist you in reaching the requirements for the necessary achievements too.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/adec1912ea19239a0d416d9c4e118ae8e044ddf7.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2]New enemy counter.[/h2][p]You’ll notice on the right side of the screen that a new icon and counter has appeared. This will assist you in knowing how many enemies that remain in the current round so you’re no longer wondering what lingers and remains in the distance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/71b466c56429649f00652376cd2ba2966b13a469.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Round countdown timer.[/h2][p]We always try to make sure that every map is bug free, and thoroughly test every section. There are rare occurrences where players will encounter glitches where Screamers will lose their way, and their navigation bugs out. Below the enemy counter, you’ll notice a clock that counts down from 5 minute intervals with every new round. Once the timer reaches 0, all remaining enemies will die, and move the player onto the next round. This will remedy those rare occurrences where the last Screamer cannot be found, soft-locking the player, and forcing them to quit their game, forfeiting their score.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/41b6f64feb8282020c939ab29032f0a5b6560f27.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Other additions:[/h3][list][*][p]Finding the game too easy? Well, no worries. On round 10, Screamer running speeds increase by 15% with a new running animation. Still too easy? Well on round 20, they’ll have another 15% buff in their speed. I hope you have the level 3 sprint perk by then.[/p][/*][*][p]Added brand new music in new ROT map[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds when buying weapons and ammo to “confirm” purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]4 new achievements have been to complete RHP and ROT in both standard mode, and nightmare mode.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Fixes and changes:[/h3][list][*][p]RHP has had its sky and distant terrain changed to fit the wasteland theme.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the health of both Machine Screamers and the butcher to make them less bullet sponges.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of both the shotgun and sniper, making them feel like proper power weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of enemy navigation with all maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objective errors in RHP.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where text didn’t appear when buying perks and other scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skin errors with weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a golden machine Screamer at round 10, and replaced it with a regular one in RHP since it didn’t belong in that map.[/p][/*][*][p]Jumping has been restored to 100% height.[/p][/*][*][p]The SMG has been moved to the lower left leg when not in use.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the cost of the self revival perk to 5,000 points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some broken requirements for achievements.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]That’s about it for now.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has provided positive feedback and has shared their suggestions. There is much more coming in the pipeline and I’m excited to share more further down the line. Have a good weekend.[/p][p][/p][h1]-Mr. Ox.[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/15a2918ef9aa5c07f4a1e59e0d72dcd993bc3216.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: TC:WA Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello all, introducing a brand new update for the weekend. This update is a big one. I'm excited to go through the new features and changes that you can now play. Let's get right to it!

[h2][u][b]New features:[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]Red Hill Peninsula.[/h3]
[/list]
This new map is a breath of fresh air! You are now stranded at an old hill, untouched by the bombs from the Grey War, that was once owned by a secretive old man who has now vanished. This place may be a hidden paradise to some, but you'll soon find out that this isn’t the case.

Objective: Repair the old broken down car with three major components that will get you out of here in one piece. Only one component can be carried at a single given time, so be sure to fix it to the car before picking up another item.

[list]
[*] [h3]Nightmare mode.[/h3]
[/list]
This mode introduces a new, and fatal spin to how you play the game. Nightmare mode will surely be a challenge if you find the existing levels too easy. Both the Asylum level and the brand new Red Hill Peninsula will feature the Nightmare mode, including future levels that are in development.

Objective: Escape by all means in the pitch darkness. Your only friends is a flashlight, and you guns. Not only will items be more expensive, and have extra objectives to complete, but you will take more damage compared to the normal mode. Oh, and the generator will turn off every 5 minutes.

[list]
[*] [h3]BMG.[/h3]
[/list]
The Bandit machine gun is a new weapon that has been added in both maps. Hope you’re packing plenty of ammo, because this high recoil, bullet spitting death machine may just be everyone’s new favourite weapon. With a high magazine count, and a frightening rate of fire, this may just be the weapon to get you high in the leaderboards.

[list]
[*] [h3]Medals.[/h3]
[/list]
Boost your final score by killing as many screamers as possible, and by earning as much points as you keep drawing breath. Depending on your performance, medals will range from bronze, and all the way to diamond. In the end, when you either meet your inevitable fate, or survive, you final score will be altered, depending on how well you stive.


[h2][b][u]Minor changes[/u][/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] The menu has been touched up
[*] Added a new loading screen
[*] 5 new achievements
[*] Implemented a credit system and XP system. Nothing can be done with this now, but will be expanded upon later.
[*] Corrected a lot of character poses
[*] Once hitting round 15, Screamers will now run towards the player. Watch out!
[*] Firing without aiming is now easier to pull off. Before, the camera suddenly snaps.
[*] Adjusted health to the spectrum of enemies, depending on the round the player is on.
[*] A lot of other minor fixes have been applied.
[/list]

DLC 2 was meant to be out today, but we ran into some minor things that we have to fix. But I just couldn’t wait in releasing this build, so why not check out the store page and wishlist it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417420/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_2/]right here![/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/052f5ca457827af0cf29cfb0d63587bab024de36.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/f701ece7f4fcf823bc31c2a2a7088f8c5dd285b4.jpg[/img][/url]

Oh, and the first DLC is on sale. So if you wish to help me out, and show your support, grab this at a low price [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409530/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_1/]right here![/url]

And if you really like where this game is going and wish to help me out further, come and check out my ko-fi page and consider throwing a few dollars my way to keep this train rolling. [u][url=https://ko-fi.com/goldenoxstudios]Click here[/url] [/u]to find out more.

notes.title: Patch update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi all. For this week update, here is a quick hotfix update to address a few fixes that were present with the latest build.

[list]
[*] Added scars and minor marks on Trixie to suit her violent background
[*] On round 10, there were 2 golden machine screamers that spawned. We’ve removed one so the player doesn’t have a second golden key unnecessarily
[*] A couple of text corrections
[*] There were parts where the music was playing up, cutting out unexpectedly, this has been addressed
[*] There are more Screamers that will rush the player during the finale
[*] Blood splats and decals last longer
[*] After round 10, Screamers are now faster
[*] Lowered the health of Machine Screamers
[*] Removed some smoke placements outside the asylum
[*] Added some painted arrows on the floor to help fresh players who are unfamiliar with the game and the objective.
[*] During the finale, there were moments when enemies ran past the player and stood in a crowd for a short moment before pursuing them again. This has been addressed.
[*] There were times when the player could get softlocked on round 5, because the Machine Screamer got stuck on the stairs. This has now been fixed.
[*] Fixed a few misplaced HUD elements for people who use an ultra-widescreen monitor (you guys are people too)
[/list]

That’s all for now. Have a pleasant rest of the week. I’ll check back in soon with some more content updates.

-Mr. Ox

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am very pleased to finally share the newest 1.1.0 update. I'll cut right to the chase and list all of the newest editions to the game, with the fixes to follow.

But first, if you wish to support me, I’d like to celebrate the latest update by sharing two pieces of purchasable DLC for the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/459346559fa93f5c219fef4174952fc94e913924.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/19b8d5464fa8c7b71c4c488d91db2e5cdaea180a.jpg[/img][/url][b]TC:WA soundtrack.[/b]
This features all of the current music in the game, including some upcoming tracks that will be applied to the game later in future updates. You can get it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2176350/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault_Soundtrack/]here[/url].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/755b59062d632574510e1919700936496c04529e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/0e68f3c84f6a1abaa50e5f8f41839c4ecc0dbcee.jpg[/img][/url][b]TC:WA supporter pack 1[/b]
Introducing the first skins DLC that can be applied to all weapons currently in the game, including the new battle rifle that is included in this latest update. It’ll also give you the ability to change your laser colour to green for the attachments that can be applied. You can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409530/The_Chronicles_Wasteland_Assault__Supporter_Pack_1/]here[/url], with 40% already off the cheap price.

[h3]Major additions:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Map extension and finale: Find all three keys to escape the asylum and to explore outside the grounds. Have the ability to escape if you can start up the car, and survive the finale onslaught, adding more to your final score.
[*] Battle rifle: Try out the new semi-automatic precision weapon, located on the second floor of the asylum. Being a reliable medium ranged weapon, it may just become your favourite firearm.
[*] New Screamers: Zombies be gone! Introducing the true horrors of the wasteland: Screamers! A great representation of how these violent, unreasonable beings are seen in my novels.
[*] New gore system: Explosive headshots, blood puddles and spattering chunks will surely be therapeutic, and bring you back for more. (After dozens of hours play testing these builds, seeing this never gets old. I may need help)
[*] Selectable characters, and gun inspection: Three playable characters have been added to the game, each with their lore-friendly background and five selectable skins to change up their tone. You can also inspect each usable weapon, read how they work, and how each attachment changes the behaviour of your weapon. Did you purchase the supporter pack DLC? Here is where you’ll be able to apply the skins, and change the laser colour.
[*] Leaderboards: What the highest score you can reach? Show it off on the Steam leaderboards. (This may be altered sometime in the future to cater to different modes and fixes.)
[/list]

[h3]Minor additions and changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] You can now spend 1,500 points to on the second floor to unlock a quick escape back to the first floor. This is a great way to avoid using the tight and narrow stairs down. Be warned however, for you must use the stairs to climb back up.
[*] AR damage has been lowered by 25% while the shotgun has seen a 200% damage buff! (Whoa!)
[*] My fourth book has been added to the extras menu.
[*] You can now see your stowed weapons on your characters body.
[*] Fixed a bug where holding F to repair a barrier can be done no matter where you were in the map.
[*] The scope attachment for the sniper now zooms in much further than any other weapon.
[*] Added a new picture to the loading screen.
[*] Added 2 new achievements.
[*] A whole bunch of other minuscule bugs have been squished.
[/list]

[h3]Known issues that will be corrected:[/h3]

[list]
[*] When switching weapons, the camera sometimes snaps in a certain direction.
[*] Depending on the character you’re playing, the shoulders on the player model look very high while in the shack level.
[*] Only 1 golden machine Screamer is meant to spawn on round 10, but there appears to be 2 right now, earning you two gold keys when you kill them
[*] The laser for the supporter pack appears blue, when it’s meant to be green.
[/list]

What to expect next?
Besides more bug fixes, we are moving on to work on a new map, one that will be bigger and more open than the asylum. Along with that will be yet another new weapon, another playable character, and a few other additional pieces of content to explore in the game.
Thank you to all of those who have shown their support, either through kind words, a positive review, and to those who consider purchasing the new DLC. I look forward to sharing more with you all in the coming weeks.

Mr. Ox

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/15a2918ef9aa5c07f4a1e59e0d72dcd993bc3216.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c1f18d5560d3cd858807153b6140f17629ce6aee.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: TC:WA Update 1.02
notes.notes:
[h1][b]TLDR:[/b][/h1] For this update, you'll notice the new safezone that you'll load into once you press play. This place will play a much larger roll in the future. For now however, enjoy the peaceful atmosphere, and use the table inside the cabin to launch the asylum level. Check below to see specific update notes.

A lot of progress has been made this week. You'll notice that once you hit the play button, you'll be taken to a new area that will serve as a player hub, where in the future, you'll be able to choose what level you will like to play, and even further down the line, there will be many more exciting things to do there.

[u][b]Major additions:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] New Safezone map
[*] Leaderboards (currently, it is only a template for now, but within the next few days, it will be functioning properly)
[*] New HUD elements. (Right hand side, showing new players how to evade and access their weapon wheel)
[/list]

[u][b]Minor additions / fixes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Volume slider for music
[*] Volume slider for general sound
[*] Shadows are set to high by default
[*] Players will now start off with 500 points on a new game (We're testing the waters to see if this makes the start too easy)
[*] Barriers now no longer break by themselves if there are no Screamers present
[*] Two invisible walls on the first floor have been removed (before, players couldn't hit spawning Screamers in the hallway barriers)
[*] The size of the picture preview in "buy the books" have been reduced by 25%
[*] SMG now fires 50% faster
[*] The sniper could penetrate multiple enemies without having the 5th attachment
[*] Removed some instances of Screamers getting stuck on the barriers
[*] You can now repair barriers by holding F instead of having to press it over and over again
[*] Resolved a bug where the butcher kills you with one hit, regardless of what rank of buffer you had
[*] Removed the backpack from the character
[*] Removed two cots upstairs, allowing to train a line of Screamers easier
[*] Achievements should be functioning properly. Before, they we're unlocked at inconsistent times, or not at all. Either way, we'll keep an eye out.
[/list]

[u][b]What to expect in the next few weeks:[/b][/u]

With the asylum level being our "testing grounds" I am happy with the way it is. The formula of how the gameplay works is at a point to where I'd like to stick with it, and further expand it on more levels to come. So, with that said, the next update will be a few weeks away, but it will be a [b]BIG [/b] one, possibly bigger than the game now, how it was at launch, so look forward to that.
I'm wanting to add an extra weapon to the game, a new, and bigger map, more playable characters, new Screamer models, and a few more additions to top it off.

Again, like always, you are welcome to leave your feedback here, our discussions page, and even look at our [url=https://trello.com/b/gVZgk8oA/tcwa-update-board]Trello[/url] to see the progress we're making.

Thanks for all of the support shown by everyone. I'm very eager to get a move on, and further expand this game into something bigger.

Mr. Ox
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/15a2918ef9aa5c07f4a1e59e0d72dcd993bc3216.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c1f18d5560d3cd858807153b6140f17629ce6aee.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New version now live!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]TLDR:[/b][/h3]
I am pleased to announce that the new version of TC:WA is now live! If you encounter any trouble with this build, it is probably already being addressed on the Trello. On the main menu, be sure to set the volume to on in the settings. It may have been left off by default, this will be addressed in the next build. Let me know what you think of the new game.
Have fun.

[b]The time has come. [/b]

I am very happy to share our latest work with everybody. After testing out this build, I have already noted down some fixes that will be addressed with this upcoming patch in the coming days. I had the idea of waiting a week before letting this go live, but then I thought, “why not release it now, and if the game has to be altered in any way (difficulty wise) then we can adjust that at the same time.”
So, if you’re reading this after giving the game a go, what is going to happen after today? I will leave behind some Q&A, if you’re question doesn’t appear here, then feel free to ask in the discussion tab.

[b]Q: What are the controls?[/b]
A: I have my artist working on a picture that will layout all of the controls. Until then, you have the traditional [b][u]WASD[/u][/b] control scheme. [b][u]Left click[/u][/b] fires, [b][u]Right click[/u][/b] aims. Holding [b][u]TAB[/u][/b] brings up the weapon wheel, crouch with [b][u]C[/u][/b] evade attacks with [b][u]Q[/u][/b], and sprint with [b][u]SHIFT[/u][/b]

[b]Q: Why only one level?[/b]
A: Basically, the best answer I can give is that I want to make this formula right. Making the level was the easy part. However, I want to give players a challenging experience, but nothing that’s too hard and unfair, this level is perfect to test all of that out. In the next couple of week, once we get everything right, that's when the new levels will start rolling out.

[b]Q: I have a request/suggestion/bug report.[/b]
I work a stupid amount of hours every week, but I try to keep my eye on the discussions page. If you post something, I'll try to answer as soon as possible. Also, keep an eye on the [url=https://trello.com/b/gVZgk8oA/tcwa-update-board]Trello[/url], you're fix/suggestion might already be in the works.

I really hope everyone can enjoy this new vision of my game. I have so many ideas that I can't wait to share with everybody. Have a good weekend.

-Mr. Ox

notes.title: Conversion update!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]TLDR:[/b][/h2] Revamped the game into a new version. The existing game is now a free demo to all. A new, and overhauled version will come out later in the coming weeks to replace it.



[b]So... what's been happening?[/b]

Wow. Time sure does fly. To me, this past year of my life has flashed on by. Looking back at everything that has been shows that; as your life progresses, you truly understand that the seconds that pass by are precious. I say this because, I really haven’t felt that more than a year has already been since launching The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault.

After financially recovering from my eye surgery, I got back in contact with Tec-Sheild, and we have completely transformed TC:WA into something much more ambitious.
The first launch, last year, taught me a lot on how to handle not only developing a video game, but how to show it off to the public, and saying that my game is worth your time to enjoy. To get lost in the story that I want to tell. Since restarting this year, I’m excited to show off the relaunch of TC:WA V.2!

Right now, I have made the existing game as a free demo. If you still haven't tried the old version, now is the time to give it a go, because in a couple of weeks, it'll be gone. If you have played the game previously, you will definitely notice the difference in the feel of gameplay and detail of the revamped world that will come out soon. Currently, you will be able to play a mode that will be available in the full version that will be released in the near future. This is called Survival mode. CoD Zombie veterans will feel right at home in this mode, but you’ll notice that I have put my own twist in the gameplay.
Survival mode demands players to hold out for as long as possible until their inevitable death. The aim is to score as high as possible and to reach the top ranks in the public scoreboards (you know... just like CoD). This demo mode will feature one full map to give you a taste on what to expect the full version to be, with some modifications and changes, of course.

Along with the full version will also come with a single player mode, a campaign with a story behind it. Here, you’ll be able to customize your character and your weapons, tame wild Screamers to serve you, and to battle them out to make a name for yourself in the wasteland. It’s a big project, and I’m excited to share even more with everyone when the time is right.

Until then, try this mode out once it's available. See what you think of it, and feel free to provide feedback. Follow me on this journey to see how things are going with the full version that will provide a brand new (hopefully never seen before) experience for everyone. Below are a few screenshots of the new demo.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Hello all![/b]

It’s been a hot minute, but for good reason. There’s quite a lot of things to get through right now so I’m not going to waste any time and will go through the changes this new build has. Afterwards I’ll be highlighting what the team and I are going to be up to in the next coming weeks.

[h1]First off, the map overhaul.[/h1]

This map still uses the same landscape and locations as the previous world. If you’ve played this before, you should notice some… minor changes to the level.
As I’ve mentioned before, the map that the game launched with was a good starting point, however I wasn’t satisfied with the aesthetic of the world and it doesn’t reflect well in my books. If you were to play this game and read the novels, you would think that these are two completely different worlds. This build changes that by, well, making the map look like it’s gone though a whole century.
However, I am going to cut this section short, because this isn’t going to be the final version of the world. In the coming months, there are going to be some serious changes to the game itself. I’ll explain more further down but I’ll quickly cover a cut feature that I don’t think many people knew of.

[h1]Top down mode.[/h1]

This game has gone through several changes since we started this project around 2 years ago. The game was meant to be exclusively an isometric game, where the player survives wave after wave against Screamers, think of CoD: Zombies.
Over time however, new ideas came, and soon enough, third person was implemented and with ever update, top down mode because more and more obsolete to a point where the mode was broken and unusable. With the way the game plays now, third person is much more suited as a default mode anyway. So we removed the top down mode and replaced the TAB button to switch shoulders of the character so you’ll have an easier time to look around corners.


[b]But that’s pretty much it…[/b]

Besides a few minor fixes, this is how the game will be… for now
Recently I have had a thought, something that’ll pretty much change TC:WA for good in a positive light. These past few months after releasing the game has taught me so much in how to handle building a game, showing it off to thousands of people and releasing it for the public to play. Besides a few harsh comments, this has been a huge learning curve for me and now I’m ready to take it up to the next gear. Doing this will take a bit of time, but after observing how everything turned out, the wait will surely be worth it.
Let me walk you through what’s in the oven right now.

[b]Character creation.[/b]
I’ve grown up as someone who loves RPGs, you name it: The Elder Scrolls series, Mass Effect, Fallout and so many others. I’m actually doing a new playthrough of Mass Effect Legendary edition right now and the crucial component of such games always have one thing that I absolutely adore: character creation.

Nothing is better to me than seeing a reflection of myself in a virtual world where I’m the hero. I want this to be the case for TC:WA! What we’re doing right now is going to be quite literally a game changer. The team at TecShield are currently experimenting with a powerful new tool that will give the player endless freedom to how they want their character that is surviving the wasteland to look.
[url=https://www.instagram.com/zaighamgram/]Zaighamgram[/url] is doing a fantastic job making sure this implements into the game seamlessly. Not only will you be able to customize the way your character looks in the game, but you will also choose their background and their alignment to truly immerse you in this world. Right now, there is very little to show off right now. These next coming weeks will be focusing on adjusting everything to fit properly into the game itself. After this has been done however, there is going to be more!

[b]Base building and world overhaul![/b]
The underground bunker was a good start in terms of giving the player a place in not having to worry about the dangers of the outside world. To me however, it wasn’t MY safezone, that’s what kind of gave me doubts after releasing the game, Other players will experience the same place that didn’t really allow them to say “this is my safezone” if that makes sense. You were really a guest in someone else’s bunker and after a while, you didn’t really feel like it was a place that you belong.
This is what I’m striving to do now. Having a large landscape that the player can call their own and build their camp into a stronghold where they can be proud of what they’ve built.
As I mentioned before, the world will change as well. One that will be custom made instead of a pre-built map that exists currently. That’s what I meant by this won’t be the final version to the world with this build. After the previous two modules are completed, a new map will be forged that will properly be optimized and made to cater to a mysterious wasteland, full of secrets and horrors.

In saying all of this, the current build (V:1.2.0) will be as is for a while now. Not that anyone is playing this game anyways, I’m pretty much typing this out as if I’m talking to myself. But if you’re someone who already owns the game and is reading this far out of curiosity; thank you, there’s going to be a lot of exciting new features that are going to be put in over the coming months. Even if there’s going to be a slow-down on game builds, I’ll still be updating everyone on how things are going ever few weeks/fortnights.

That is all for now, thank you for your support and for reading on.

-Mr. Ox

notes.notes:
Hello there. Another fortnight update and I’m pretty excited to share this update with everyone. Now this isn’t the BIGGEST update that we have planned but this will definitely add some excitement to the world. I’m just gonna get straight into it and will share our future plans after listing the changes.

[h1]What’s new:[/h1]

[h2]Prologue level![/h2]
This level begins at the very start of a new game. This will show you how the main mechanics will work and will allow you get a good idea on what to expect further on. You will play as an unnamed survivor who hears a ruckus outside. It’s up to you to investigate and find out what has happened.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/c02925addac656cccd0089449ee49f10ec514060.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] New settings: Toggleable enemy health bar
[*] New hidden achievement: Hume teaches us…
[/list]

[h1]What’s fixed/changed:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Shotgun has been buffed
[*] Machine Screamer spawn has been fixed outside of church
[*] Achievements should now appear as soon as you meet the requirements. Before you had to check the achievement tab in the main menu for it to unlock. Now it should unlock instantly
[/list]

[h1]What’s next:[/h1]

Now this is the exciting part; something that has been in the backburner for a while now. I’ve mentioned it before that this current city map is more of a foundation for what I really want my game to be. What we have now is an apocalyptic map that feels like that only a few years have passed while in my novels, it’s been over 100 years. I’m please to share just a few images of what to expect for the next upcoming update that will pretty much overhaul everything that this current world is now.

That’s everything… for now…

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello all. Just in time for the summer sale with a brand-new fortnightly update. I will be honest; I must have completely misread Steam and the sale date because I swear I read that it was starting late July, like the 20th or something. Kinda shocked me when I saw that it was starting now. Nevertheless, this update is quite the chunky one with a few new additions. It originally took a week to implement but then we took an additional week to fix the bugs that were present. If you think this update is impressive, wait until you see what we have in store for the next couple of weeks.

Now just to let everyone know, the next update that’s coming on the 15th will reset everything. This obviously includes progress, but it’s for a good reason of course; there will be a new prologue introduction for new players to properly show them what this game is about. For Halo Reach players, think about the Lone wolf mission and how that ended. I think that’ll be a great way to introduce everyone to what this world holds.

It’s been over a month now since TC:WA came out and already I’ve learnt a lot about how to handle launches, feedback and updates. Thanks to everyone who’s been positive and have provided constructive comments about how we can make this game better. Other than that, here are the new patch notes:

[h1]What’s new:[/h1]

[h2]New Screamers![/h2]
[list]
[*] Armoured Screamers: Just like your normal enemy but takes more to bring down.
[*] Machine Screamers: To fight, or not to fight. Do not cross this foe when you’re low on ammunition. They hit pretty hard too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/703e3696ffcb54d4f7ad32207fd4f13dd0bc965c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/3b8b5b2fc2a66a41174b3375fc9f23fd39489060.jpg[/img]

[/list]
[list]
[*] Updated mission board. We have revamped the missions into more of a neater collection. We have remade the purification missions with better rewards and will add more in the coming weeks.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/503773289c9909236be8cc7d66c2981ce42338a0.jpg[/img]

[h1]What’s fixed/changed:[/h1]

Lootable misc objects now sparkle white
Chests give off a blue sparkle
Removed purple eye icon from the map for misc loot
A lot of other minor bugs have been resolved.

[h1]What’s next:[/h1]

Implement a new prologue mission. (This update will wipe the game into a new save)
Buff some weapons
Add new bounty board missions
Lootable chests that hold high tier rewards…

What is also being worked on is new assets including buildings and clutter around the world. To put it simply: I’m sure almost everyone knows that a majority of this game world has shared assets that a lot of Unity developers use, mostly including apocalyptic type of games. These assets have been great to use as building blocks to make the game. However, I’m now wanting to diverge this existing map into a more personally crafted one that suits my world better.

If you take one look at the world, you would think that only 10 or 20 years have passed since the apocalypse began. In my novels however, it’s been over 100 years and the world would look so much more different compared to what’s in the game now.
[url=https://www.thechronicleswasteland.com/]*cough cough* insert self-promotion here…[/url]

That is all for now. I’m looking forward to sharing this next specific update with everyone.

Mr. Ox

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A new patch is out and things are looking pretty good. The new looting system is finished and the team has added over 430 new locations for you to find items to help you on your journey. We’ll be tweaking it a bit more so that the items can be searched again after some time has passed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42861570/96b1fb8f61be59a3e9ace8003e85f3d2fa3a625f.png[/img]

[h2]Changed/Fixed:[/h2]

Made an item that couldn’t be picked up now… pick-up-able?

Bandit guard now drops keycard on death.

Fixed a text bug where it says the player picked up ammo when they haven’t walked over it yet.

Back button for wizard is now functional.

Sometimes was impossible to pick up loot depending on what item you search; player can now easily pick up items.

Screamers now only drop body parts on death.

Sized ammo pickups down by 50%

[h2]What’s new:[/h2]

The AR could only be unlocked by finishing the first 4 missions given by Kin-Yar. The player then had to unlock the blacksmith and equip it from there. This has now changed. Upon unlocking zone 2, the player should see a battle that has been lost with a survivor and 3 Screamers. Their AR and spare ammo should be laying there for the player to pick up. It is now theirs to own and customize.

All other zones on the map now has misc loot containers.

New button prompts for players under the map. (We might add all controls on the right side of the screen for new players with a hotkey toggle to hide and show these buttons)

[h2]What to expect next week:[/h2]

The AR that the player picks up in zone 2 has a bug where it dumps its mag within a second after pulling the trigger. We’ll fix that.

Adding new Screamer variants.

New missions!

That's it for this week. What we're working on next will add so much more life and thills to the game. I look forward to sharing this with everyone. Until then, have a good weekend.

-Mr. Ox

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Heaps of bug squishes and a few extra additions

Hi everyone. I’m pleased to share our first patch for this week. The team have tested the game a lot and we’ve changed a few things around thanks to players’ feedback. Starting a new game for some players should now be much more straightforward now.

[h2]Changed/Fixed:[/h2]
Third person crosshair is toggleable through options
Top down crosshair is always enabled
The player won’t be able to go out side until he is required to.
The player is prompted clearly with icons to where to go in the start.
Fix Wizard card menu, players should be able to merge duplicate cards to make stronger versions
Fix various ammo bugs: Ammo in the minus, or purchase ammo bug
Fix bandit guard bugs
Fix players arms flapping around when talking to bandit
Bandit engage with dialogue even after he is killed
Player doesn't gain skill points
Fix female evade rank 1
Shotgun should do more damage and reload faster
Make sniper do more damage
Size sniper down
Make the swappable character appear after the tutorial is over
Bandit should not spawn only ammo when killed
Player falling off map when entering water
Medkits are very common, we’ve now lowered the chance of getting them
Lootable Screamer hands and feet don’t appear as pick ups
Game Stuck if player press esc key when game scene is loading is now fixed
Fixed collision with multiple objects
Removed floating object in front of powerplant door
Player could pass through powerplant doors without unlocking them
Fixed hole in the world near the start
Interaction with the blacksmith has been fixed

[h2]What’s new:[/h2]
6 new achievements
Minimap in bunker to guide the player
Added health and stamina icons
Prompt the player on picking up the unlocking item for a door

[h2]Known issues to fix in this build[/h2]
Might encounter aiming bug after switching to top-down mode. Go to bunker and back out to city to fix
A couple of drops from Screamers can't be picked up
A Screamer may drop an equipment card that hasn't been implimented into the game just yet.

That's everything for this week. Next week we'll keep an eye out for more bugs but also begin working on adding new missions and other exciting content.

Keep track with us using Trello here:
https://trello.com/b/gVZgk8oA/tcwa-update-board

Have a good week

-Mr. Ox
